make.name: smart
make.parent_group: smart Automobile Co., Ltd. (Mercedes-Benz Group and Geely joint venture)
make.description: City-car brand founded in 1994 as a Daimler-Swatch venture, known for the two-seat fortwo built in Hambach, France. Since 2019-2020 it has been a 50:50 joint venture of Mercedes-Benz and Geely in Ningbo, China, selling only electric cars (#1, #3, #5 and the #2 city car).

models.name: EQ fortwo
models.description: Battery-electric version of the two-seat fortwo, offered as a coupe and a cabrio. Sold as the fortwo electric drive from 2009 and renamed EQ fortwo in 2018; production of the fortwo ended in 2024 and the #2 is its electric successor.

generations.name: Second generation (451)
generations.description: About 2,000 cars with a Tesla-supplied battery, leased or used in car2go car-sharing in 18 markets. (The 2007 London field trial of 100 first-generation cars is not counted as a sales model.)

generations.name: Third generation (451)
generations.description: Series-production electric drive with a 17.6 kWh battery and a 55 kW motor, sold widely including the US.

generations.name: Fourth generation (453)
generations.description: New 453 body shared with the Renault Twingo, 17.6 kWh battery and 60 kW motor; renamed EQ fortwo from 2018.

variants.name: fortwo electric drive / EQ fortwo coupe
fortwo electric drive / EQ fortwo cabrio

generations.name: Facelift
generations.description: Facelift (electric-only) with a new front and the same 60 kW drivetrain; Europe only.

models.name: EQ forfour
models.description: Four-door, four-seat electric version of the 453 forfour (a Renault Twingo twin), sold in Europe as the forfour electric drive from 2017 and as the EQ forfour from 2018 until about 2022.

generations.name: Original
generations.description: 17.6 kWh battery and 60 kW rear motor.

generations.name: Facelift
generations.description: Facelift with the new smart front; same drivetrain.

models.description: Compact electric SUV and the first car from the Mercedes-Benz/Geely smart joint venture, built in China on Geely's SEA platform and on sale since 2022. Mercedes-Benz styled it; Geely engineers and builds it.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: SEA platform; rear motor (49 kWh LFP or 66 kWh NMC battery) or dual-motor Brabus.

models.description: Coupe-styled electric SUV, a sibling of the #1 on Geely's SEA platform, launched in China in 2023 and in Europe in 2024.
Mid-size electric SUV on Geely's SEA platform with an 800-volt system, unveiled in June 2024 and sold in Europe since 2025. A plug-in hybrid #5 EHD is sold in China and is not covered here.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Rear or dual motors with a 76 kWh LFP or 100 kWh NMC battery.

models.description: Two-seat electric city car and successor to the fortwo, launched in China in November 2026 with European orders from October 2026.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Rear-motor city car with a 35.8 kWh LFP battery.
